subject: land.sh docs lane accepts discussions/; .gitignore ignores memory/**/*.consumed (gap #52)
objective: The consolidator's discussion files and candidate drafts under discussions/ can be landed through 'sh scripts/land.sh docs' like tickets/ docs/ memory/; any other prefix is still refused by name with rc=2. The inbox backups that 'memory.py consolidate' moves to memory/**/<inbox>.<run_id>.consumed are ignored by git, so 'git status' after a consolidation no longer lists them. land.sh header comment and usage text, docs/WORKFLOW.md docs-lane section, and the docs/reference/role-procedures.md line 'discussion files are not in the land.sh docs prefix whitelist (#52)' say the new four-prefix rule.
acceptance: A1 In a sandbox repo on main, 'sh scripts/land.sh docs "msg" discussions/2026-10-26-memory-x.md' exits 0 and 'git show --name-only main' lists exactly that file; the gate does not run.

A2 'sh scripts/land.sh docs "msg" tickets/7.json scripts/sneaky.sh' still exits 2, names scripts/sneaky.sh on stderr and main does not move; the usage line (docs with no files) names all four prefixes tickets/ docs/ memory/ discussions/; AC_ROLE=opener still accepts only tickets/<AC_TICKET>.json (a discussions/ file is refused for the opener).

A3 In this repo, after creating untracked memory/role/x.inbox.md.20261026-000000-1.consumed and memory/model/y.inbox.md.20261026-000000-2.consumed, 'git status --porcelain' lists neither, and 'git check-ignore -v' attributes both to the new .gitignore line memory/**/*.consumed.
A4 Existing full suite stays green (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests, plus the gate as land runs it); no existing test is edited except tests/test_land.py wording that counts 'three' prefixes.
test_plan: T1 (A1) integration, tests/test_land.py docs-lane class, reuse its sandbox helpers (self.docs, self.write, self.git, gate_ran): write discussions/<date>-memory-x.md, run docs lane, expect rc 0, landed file list == [that path] (expected value = the path the test wrote), gate_ran() False. Feature: docs lane (no verify tag; cases live in tests/). Mutation: remove discussions/ from DOCS_PREFIXES -> T1 red (rc 2). T2 (A2) integration, same class: existing test_a_file_outside_the_three_prefixes_is_refused_by_name must stay green unchanged in assertions (may be renamed); extend test_usage_names_the_three_prefixes to also expect discussions/ (expected list typed in the test, not read from land.sh); new case AC_ROLE=opener AC_TICKET=7 with discussions/x.md -> rc 2. Mutation: make prefix check accept everything -> outside-prefix test red. T3 (A3) unit-level repo check, new test in tests/ (e.g. tests/test_gitignore_consumed.py or an existing memory test module): run 'git check-ignore --no-index -q' from the real repo root on the two paths above, expect rc 0 for both, and rc 1 for memory/role/x.inbox.md (inbox itself must stay tracked). Expected values from this ticket, not from .gitignore parsing. Mutation: delete the .gitignore line -> T3 red. T4 (A4) full suite via gate at land.
